aboutText: With over 15 years of experience in Yarraville, Extend Pro is your trusted local builder for all construction needs. We specialise in high-quality extensions, renovations, and new home builds, ensuring every project is completed on time and within budget. Our commitment to reliable service and exceptional craftsmanship has made us a preferred choice for homeowners across Melbourne's western suburbs.
servicesText: Extend Pro provides a full suite of building services designed to transform your property. From concept to completion, our skilled team handles everything with professionalism and care. We are dedicated to delivering results that enhance the value and comfort of your home.
